title: Queen of the Infernal Realm
description: A pale queen with long white braided hair stands on a cracked stone path in a volcanic wasteland. She wears a black crown, a dark purple gothic gown with a high slit, fishnet stockings, and holds a heavy chain, with a massive blood-red sun dominating the fiery sky behind her and a ruined gothic castle to the left.
prompt: A beautiful pale queen with long flowing white braided hair and a black spiked crown stands on broken volcanic stone in a hellish landscape. She wears a tight black and purple gothic dress with a high slit revealing fishnet stockings and holds a heavy iron chain. Behind her is a crumbling dark gothic castle with glowing windows, rivers of lava, and a giant cracked blood-red sun filling the smoky sky. A weathered sign on the right reads 'NO RETURN' with a crossed-out E symbol. Dramatic cinematic lighting, dark fantasy style.
